result: Final seven-page PDF re-rendered. Conventional RX and TX wiring layouts reviewed at high resolution; no clipped titles, overlapping references/values, or unclear feedback connections observed.

R20/R21/C13 reference divider and actual U1A follower feedback loop.
GPIO16 through R15/Q2/U2/R17/Q1 to piezo, with actual R27/R16/R18/R19 wiring.
Vertical resistor/capacitor references and values remain horizontal and separated.
native_ids: All original physical references and symbol UUIDs preserved; unit-A PCB association remains unchanged and is accepted by schematic-parity DRC.
